Supports 6,000 APs, 64,000 clients, and 6,000 branches 802.11ac Wave 2 Service providers, enterprises, and large campuses Highly scalable, service rich, and flexible

Optimized for 802.11ac Wave2 performance, the Cisco 8540 Wireless LAN Controller is a highly scalable, service-rich, resilient, and flexible platform. It provides centralized control, management, and troubleshooting for high-scale deployments in service provide, enterprise, and large campus deployments.

text.text: The 8540 comes with integrated services: Application Visibility and Control (AVC) provides granular classification and prioritization of thousands of business-critical apps with dynamic protocol updates Location-aware Bonjour and Chromcast can enable various services to be advertised across a Layer 3 network at a user and device level An embedded policy classification engine offers simplified BYOD with native device profiling and onboard services Software-defined segmentation with Cisco TrustSec reduces access control list maintenance, complexity, and overhead The 8540 Series offers exceptional scalability: Optimize 802.11ac Wave 2 next-generation networks with 40 Gb throughput Support up to 6000 access points and 64,000 clients Consolidate multiple controllers into one with a single point of touch Support centralized, distributed, and mesh deployments Deploy Cisco FlexConnect in sites with up to 100 access points, in up to 2000 groups The 8540 offers high-availability features for uninterrupted application availability and no incremental system downtime: Sub-second failover for access point and client failover for uninterrupted application availability Dual-redundant 1 Gigabit or 10 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity Dual-redundant power supplies installed (AC or DC) Hot-swappable power supply and solid state storage with no incremental system downtime Enhanced system uptime with fast system restarts

graphic.text:
The 8540 comes with integrated services:

Application Visibility and Control (AVC) provides granular classification and prioritization of thousands of business-critical apps with dynamic protocol updates
Location-aware Bonjour and Chromcast can enable various services to be advertised across a Layer 3 network at a user and device level
An embedded policy classification engine offers simplified BYOD with native device profiling and onboard services
Software-defined segmentation with Cisco TrustSec reduces access control list maintenance, complexity, and overhead

The 8540 Series offers exceptional scalability:

Optimize 802.11ac Wave 2 next-generation networks with 40 Gb throughput
Support up to 6000 access points and 64,000 clients
Consolidate multiple controllers into one with a single point of touch
Support centralized, distributed, and mesh deployments
Deploy Cisco FlexConnect in sites with up to 100 access points, in up to 2000 groups

The 8540 offers high-availability features for uninterrupted application availability and no incremental system downtime:

Sub-second failover for access point and client failover for uninterrupted application availability
Dual-redundant 1 Gigabit or 10 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity
Dual-redundant power supplies installed (AC or DC)
Hot-swappable power supply and solid state storage with no incremental system downtime
Enhanced system uptime with fast system restarts
